label: Colour flood
description: A beat change made from an object on screen, not a cut. Three modes. mode "dot" (default): a coloured dot drops into place and FLOODS the whole frame -- the scene turns that colour and names it ("#BC361B / Search by color.") -- then can pull back into the dot and vanish (the Cosmos search-by-colour beat); label ink is picked for contrast. Example: {"color":"#BC361B","from_y":0.08,"at":0.3,"label":"#BC361B","sublabel":"Search by color.","retract_at":2.8}. mode "flood" (the relay scene joiner, out): a shape already on screen at from_shape (hide that piece at the same time) FLOODS the frame -- it overscales about its centre past every corner in 0.3 s (power2.in) and holds the colour to the end of the scene; no label. Example: {"mode":"flood","color":"#0b0b0c","from_shape":{"x":0.5,"y":0.62,"w":0.12,"h":0.12},"at":3.0}. mode "contract" (the join, in): the scene STARTS solid in the colour and at `at` contracts over 0.3 s (power2.out) into to_shape, the radius growing from 0 to the shape's, then stays as that shape until hide_at, where the next piece takes over at the same geometry. Example: {"mode":"contract","color":"#0b0b0c","to_shape":{"x":0.5,"y":0.5,"w":0.3,"h":0.085},"at":0.25,"hide_at":0.6} (into the pill), or {"mode":"contract","to_shape":{"x":0.5,"y":0.5,"w":0.3,"h":0.4,"radius":0},"at":0.5} (into a framed print). Shapes are frame fractions {x, y (centre), w, h, radius}; radius is a fraction of the frame's shorter side, omitted = fully round (a pill or a circle). Full-frame, above the scene.

mode.label: dot (default: a dot drops and floods, with a label) | flood (a shape on screen floods the frame) | contract (the scene opens solid and contracts into a shape)

color.label: The flood colour (hex; default #bc361b for dot, #0b0b0c for the shape modes)

at.label: dot: when the dot appears (default 0.2); flood: when the shape is on screen (default 0); contract: when it starts to contract (default 0.25)

from_shape.label: flood: the shape that floods, frame fractions {x, y, w, h, radius?}

to_shape.label: contract: the shape it contracts into, frame fractions {x, y, w, h, radius?}

duration.label: flood / contract: seconds the change takes (default 0.3)

ease.label: flood / contract: GSAP ease (default power2.in for flood, power2.out for contract)

hide_at.label: flood / contract: the shape vanishes instantly (the next piece takes over at the same geometry)

x.label: dot: where the dot lands and floods from, fraction of width (default 0.5)

from_x.label: dot: where the dot starts (default: above its mark)

from_y.label: dot: where the dot starts, fraction of height (e.g. the search chip's height)

dot_size.label: dot: dot diameter as a fraction of the width (default 0.009)

flood_at.label: When it floods (dot: default at + 0.85; flood: default at)

flood_duration.label: Seconds the flood takes (dot: default 0.6; flood: same as duration)

label.label: dot: big text on the flood (e.g. the hex)

label_at.label: dot: when the text focuses in (default just after the flood)

label_size.label: dot: label size as a fraction of the width (default 0.075)

ink.label: dot: text colour override (default: white or near-black by contrast)

retract_at.label: dot: when the flood pulls back into the dot and vanishes (omit to hold)
